notes.title: Post Here to Claim: FREE Lifetime Membership (With Purchase)
notes.content:
To thank everyone who has shown support for our team and applications, we will be providing special opportunities for everyone who purchased from us. 

For everyone who purchases or purchased this application on Steam before December 31, we will be providing you an opportunity to claim (1) free lifetime membership access to our new platform www.bettermetree.com. Follow the instructions below and we will private message you instructions.

1. You need to have purchased this application and it must be in your inventory. 
(mouse icon) next to your name.

2. Post here in this thread "Better Me".

The first week of January, we will be launching our updated community and platform and will provide everyone who qualifies and posts here, instructions on how to claim your free life time access during that week. We will also have community activities and fun events on the day we launch our updated platform so don't miss out!

*Please only post here to apply for membership. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out to us here: Contact Us

notes.title: Major Update and Launch Event November 1st
notes.content:
We upgraded our application with our first major update including an updated design, bug fixes and a few new features for settings. We are also announcing our Publisher Launch Event which will include sales for all of our applications, live events, community activities and more. Be sure to join us for the event starting November 1st!
